description: Export your applications as CSV or Markdown so you can share them or open them in a spreadsheet. Inputs: format, either csv or markdown (default markdown), and an optional status to export only that stage. The report is returned as text and nothing is written to disk. In CSV, a cell that starts with =, +, - or @ gets a leading apostrophe so spreadsheets do not run it as a formula. Example prompt: "Export all my applications as a CSV."

status.description: Only export applications in this stage.

name: export_report

count.description: How many applications are in the report.
